# ESPHome Devices

Read and control entities exposed by already-installed ESPHome firmware through Muse Home Link, using an enabled native TCP or HTTP API with its configured credentials (aioesphomeapi client or the firmware's documented HTTP API). It enumerates live entities and calls only commands advertised for each entity. There is no flashing or OTA: enabling an absent API by reflashing is not part of this skill. For ratgdo garage controllers the more specific ratgdo skill is preferred.
